method.WR: Only player-seasons classified WR_FULL_TIME by observed nflverse pass-play participation plus meaningful receiving involvement define the WR catch-rate prior.
method.TE: Only player-seasons classified TE_RECEIVING by observed nflverse pass-play participation plus meaningful receiving involvement define the TE catch-rate prior.
method.RB: RB remains separately stratified with the receiving-back workload proxy pending broad RB pass-down role enrichment.
method.metric_integrity: WR/TE pass-play participation is observed on-field dropback participation and is never called route participation.
method.catch_rate: position prior is opportunity-weighted across eligible role seasons
method.player_shrinkage: player catch rate uses only eligible-role seasons and shrinks toward the role-filtered position prior via targets/(targets+75)
method.dispersion: beta-binomial rho is estimated only from eligible receiving-role player-games
method.excluded_population: fringe/rotational WR/TE seasons remain in historical storage but do not shape foundational catch-rate priors
